text: Hebr. set not out thy glory.
Matth. 5. 25. and 18. 15. , Or, discouer not the secret of another.
Hebr. in a gift of falshood.
Or, let thy foote be seldome in thy neighbours house. , Hebr. full of thee.
Or, The Northwinde bringeth foorth raine, so doeth a backbiting tongue, an angry countenance.
